visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A high-angle close-up reveals a pink background decorated with Chiikawa characters appearing inside glass-like pods. The setting is bright and cheerful with professional studio-style lighting. A hand briefly enters the frame, pointing at a character on a promotional board. Yellow variety text appears at the bottom of the frame over the pink background. (2) The main female character with dark hair and a white top holds a blue Chiikawa plush toy and a promotional leaflet. She smiles warmly at the camera and gives a thumbs-up. The background shows the distinctive red walls and wooden benches of a Kura Sushi restaurant interior. (3) A fast-cut montage introduces five distinct friends, including three males and two females. They are sitting on a wooden bench, waving at the camera, flexing their muscles, or showing off Chiikawa charms and counters. They wear casual clothing including t-shirts, glasses, and shoulder bags. (4) The group is seen sitting at a wooden dining table in a bright restaurant. Multiple white sushi plates with blue rims are stacked or scattered across the table. Hands are shown using dark chopsticks to pick up specific sushi pieces like inari or salmon from the plates. (5) The camera focuses on a tablet screen mounted at the table which displays a colorful 2D animation of Chiikawa characters fishing. A hand inserts a plastic plate into a gray collection slot below the screen. The restaurant background is slightly blurred in the depth of field. (6) The tablet screen displays a winning message in large red characters. The main female character is shown excitedly opening a blue prize capsule to reveal a small character badge. Her facial expression is one of pure joy and accomplishment. (7) A final sequence displays a montage of various animation outcomes on the screen, followed by a group shot of everyone cheering together. They hold several prize capsules and plush toys. The lighting remains bright and consistent with a warm restaurant atmosphere.
